findings.title: Dataset quality score improved after cleaning
findings.statement: The image data quality score increased from 52.4 out of 100 to 91.6 out of 100 after processing.
findings.recommendation: Maintain the cleaning pipeline for future dataset updates.

findings.title: Class imbalance remains present in cleaned data
findings.statement: Circles represent 56.0% of the cleaned dataset, while triangles represent 13.0%, resulting in a largest to smallest ratio of 4.31.
findings.recommendation: Apply class weighting or data augmentation to balance class representation during training.

findings.title: Raw dataset contained duplicates and cross-class files
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 6 exact extra copies and 4 files duplicated across classes.
findings.recommendation: Ensure strict deduplication checks are run prior to splitting data into train and test sets to prevent data leakage.

findings.title: Image quality issues affected raw data
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 3 corrupt files, 5 blurry images, 3 too dark images, and 1 tiny image.
findings.recommendation: Filter out low-resolution and degraded images to improve feature extraction reliability.

findings.title: Suspected mislabeled images identified by AI review
findings.statement: An AI vision review observed 7 suspected mislabeled images in the dataset.
findings.recommendation: Manually inspect the flagged files to verify and correct their class labels before proceeding with training.

findings.title: Total image count reduced through cleaning
findings.statement: Cleaning operations removed 23 images in total, reducing the dataset from 123 to 100 images.
findings.recommendation: Verify that the reduced dataset size is still sufficient for the target model capacity.

narrative.headline: Dataset quality score improved to 91.6 out of 100 after cleaning, but class imbalance remains.
narrative.executive_summary: The shapes_dataset.zip dataset was cleaned for an image classifier project, reducing the total image count from 123 to 100 after removing 23 images. The data quality score increased from 52.4 out of 100 to 91.6 out of 100 through the removal of corrupt files, duplicates, blurry images, and tiny inputs. However, class imbalance persists in the cleaned data with circles representing 56.0% and triangles 13.0%, resulting in a largest to smallest ratio of 4.31. Additionally, an AI vision review flagged 7 suspected mislabeled images that require inspection.
next_steps: Verify the 7 suspected mislabeled images flagged by the AI review
Address the class imbalance where circles represent 56.0% and triangles 13.0% of the dataset
Proceed with training the image classifier using the 100 cleaned images

cleaning.description: Remove files that can't be opened as images.
cleaning.rationale: Removing files that cannot be opened is the necessary first step to ensure subsequent operations process valid data.

cleaning.description: Keep one copy of byte-identical files.
cleaning.rationale: Byte-identical files provide no additional information and inflate class counts.

cleaning.description: Keep one image per group of near-identical images (resized or re-encoded copies).
cleaning.rationale: Near-duplicates like resized versions of the same image introduce redundancy.

cleaning.description: Remove images whose duplicates appear under more than one class (ambiguous labels).
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Cross-class duplicates indicate ambiguous labeling and should be removed to prevent training noise.

cleaning.description: Remove images whose shorter side is below min_side.
cleaning.rationale: Images under 32px lack sufficient detail for reliable classification.

cleaning.description: Remove images whose blur score (Laplacian variance) is below min_blur.
cleaning.rationale: Images below the blur threshold are too degraded for accurate feature extraction.

cleaning.description: Remove images with mean brightness at or below the value.
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Images identified as too dark lack sufficient contrast for shape recognition.

cleaning.description: Remove images with mean brightness at or above the value.
cleaning.changes: Nothing needed changing: the data already met this rule.
cleaning.rationale: Images identified as too bright are washed out and lack usable visual information.

cleaning.description: Rotate images upright using their EXIF orientation tag.
cleaning.rationale: Correcting orientation ensures images are presented in their intended upright state.

cleaning.description: Convert grayscale, palette, and transparent images to RGB (transparency on white).
cleaning.rationale: Standardizing color modes ensures consistency across the dataset for model input.

cleaning.description: Mark files for human review in the manifest (nothing is removed).
cleaning.rationale: Suspected mislabels identified by AI require human verification before any destructive action is taken.
